dataScope.target: hourly-gridpoint rainfall accumulation, not flood/road impact
dataScope.thresholdSource: Fixed rainfall-amount benchmark threshold for this experiment; it is not an operational flood warning threshold.

validation.method: chronological prequential replay, test before learn, supervised labels released only at event time + horizon
validation.decisionThresholdSelection: maximum F2 on the final 365-day pre-test prequential validation stream, independently for raw and calibrated scores; thresholds frozen for test period
validation.futureLeakageGuard: NowClock rejects labels whose horizon has not matured at replay time.
validation.qualityPolicy: Reject malformed, non-monotonic, duplicate, incomplete, non-finite and negative-target rows; do not trim physically plausible high rainfall as false positives.

conformalInterval.method: rolling absolute-error split-conformal interval; empirical holdout coverage only
rolling absolute-error split-conformal interval; empirical holdout coverage only
rolling absolute-error split-conformal interval; empirical holdout coverage only
rolling absolute-error split-conformal interval; empirical holdout coverage only

rawProbabilityMetrics.calibrationMethod: online equal-width probability bins with Beta(1,1) smoothing

calibratedProbabilityMetrics.calibrationMethod: online equal-width probability bins with Beta(1,1) smoothing

drift.learningRatePolicy: Multiply online SGD learning rate by 1.5 after detector signal, subject to 0.001 regression and 0.002 classification caps; gradients are clipped to 1.0.

limitations: This is a single-gridpoint rainfall forecast replay against ERA5 reanalysis, not a flood, road-closure, or city-cascade warning model.
ERA5 reanalysis is not an independent gauge observation or archived issued forecast; metrics do not establish operational forecast skill.
The heavy-rain event label is a rainfall-amount category only. No verified flood incident labels are available for precision/recall of flood predictions.
Online binned calibration and conformal intervals are estimated from this data stream; report scores are not a deployment guarantee under spatial or temporal shift.
Only one Marine Lines location has historical input coverage. No all-India state/district accuracy or geographic transfer is claimed.
River is used by the offline training/evaluation CLI. The current Node/Vercel API does not host a Python River inference worker.
